messages.author: e19ea506112fd25b
messages.subject: overflow in neg_binomial_2_log_rng
parts:
Hi,

I think I have observed overflow condition while using neg_binomial_2_log_rng.  Since it is in generated quantities maybe just removing lower=0 will do?

Error : Invalid value of flow_pred: model14b04117381_nb1_stan_namespace::write_array(i): flow_pred[k0__] is -2147483648, but must be greater than 0
error occurred during calling the sampler; sampling not done

The code is attached.

Linas

messages.author: 89abf8a3796a510b
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] overflow in neg_binomial_2_log_rng
parts:
Hi Linas, 

You're right that changing:

int <lower = 0> flow_pred [N];     

to: 

int flow_pred [N];

will allow the model to sample (i.e. write_array will no longer throw an exception).

However, you'll still get overflow from the neg_binomial_2_log_rng, resulting in erroneous negative draws. Are you running this in RStan or CmdStan? How far into sampling do you get before you see this error?

Rob
